description: validation.py validates a user's age before persistence. It currently rejects ages above 150 but accepts negative ages, and it also accepts booleans because bool is a subclass of int. Fix validate_age() so it accepts integers in the inclusive range 0..150, rejects booleans with TypeError, and keeps raising ValueError for out-of-range numbers.
expected_behavior: validate_age(0) == 0 and validate_age(150) == 150. validate_age(-1) and validate_age(151) raise ValueError. validate_age(True) raises TypeError.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: Age validation accepts impossible values
